ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, and the chord $AC$ is parallel to the radius $OD$. Point $D$ is the midpoint of the arc $\overset{\frown}{BC}$. If $AC=OD=6$, find the area of the shaded part (the segment $AC$).
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let $CE\perp AB$ at E,\\
as shown in Figure 2, $\because AC=OD=OC=OA$,\\
$\therefore \triangle AOC$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
$\therefore \angle AOC=60^\circ$,\\
$\therefore {S}_{\text{sector} AOC}=\frac{60\pi \times {6}^{2}}{360}=6\pi$,\\
$\therefore \angle OCE=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore OE=\frac{1}{2}OC=\frac{1}{2}\times 6=3$,\\
$\therefore CE=\sqrt{3}OE=3\sqrt{3}$,\\
$\therefore {S}_{\triangle AOC}=\frac{1}{2}AO\cdot CE=\frac{1}{2}\times 6\times 3\sqrt{3}=9\sqrt{3}$,\\
$\therefore {S}_{\text{shaded}}={S}_{\text{sector} AOC}-{S}_{\triangle AOC}=6\pi -9\sqrt{3}=\boxed{6\pi -9\sqrt{3}}$.

From the text, AC=6, so C=(x,y) satisfies both x^2+y^2=36 and (x+6)^2+y^2=36. Subtract to get x=-3; because the image places C above AB, y=3sqrt(3). 图像描述：图中是一个圆，AB 是水平直径，A 在左端，B 在右端，O 在圆心且位于 AB 上。C 在圆的左上方，AC 是一条弦，阴影区域是弦 AC 与对应圆弧围成的圆弓形区域。D 在圆的右上方，OD 是一条半径，且从图中可见 AC 与 OD 方向平行。
推理：按解析几何方法，设 O=(0,0)，AB 为 x 轴，A 在左、B 在右。因为 OD=6 是半径，所以圆半径为 6，取 A=(-6,0)，B=(6,0)，圆方程为 x^2+y^2=36。又因为 AC=6，设 C=(x,y)，则 C 在圆上且到 A 的距离为 6，所以满足 x^2+y^2=36 和 (x+6)^2+y^2=36。两式相减得 (x+6)^2-x^2=0，即 12x+36=0，所以 x=-3。代入圆方程得 y^2=36-9=27。由图像可知 C 在 AB 上方，所以 y=3√3，即 C=(-3,3√3)。向量 OA=(-6,0)，OC=(-3,3√3)，其夹角满足 cos∠AOC=(OA·OC)/(6·6)=18/36=1/2，因此 ∠AOC=60°。阴影圆弓面积等于扇形 AOC 面积减去三角形 AOC 面积。扇形面积为 (60/360)π·6^2=6π。三角形面积为 |det(OA,OC)|/2=|(-6)(3√3)-0|/2=9√3。因此阴影面积为 6π-9√3。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, it is known that $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, and the chord $AC$ is parallel to the radius $OD$. Point $D$ is the midpoint of the arc $\overset{\frown}{BC}$. If $AC=OD=6$, find the area of the shaded part (the segment $AC$).
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} Let $CE\perp AB$ at E,\\
as shown in Figure 2, $\because AC=OD=OC=OA$,\\
$\therefore \triangle AOC$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
$\therefore \angle AOC=60^\circ$,\\
$\therefore {S}_{\text{sector} AOC}=\frac{60\pi \times {6}^{2}}{360}=6\pi$,\\
$\therefore \angle OCE=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore OE=\frac{1}{2}OC=\frac{1}{2}\times 6=3$,\\
$\therefore CE=\sqrt{3}OE=3\sqrt{3}$,\\
$\therefore {S}_{\triangle AOC}=\frac{1}{2}AO\cdot CE=\frac{1}{2}\times 6\times 3\sqrt{3}=9\sqrt{3}$,\\
$\therefore {S}_{\text{shaded}}={S}_{\text{sector} AOC}-{S}_{\triangle AOC}=6\pi -9\sqrt{3}=\boxed{6\pi -9\sqrt{3}}$
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure there is a circle, the center of the circle is O, AB is a horizontal diameter, A is at the left end of the circle, B is at the right end; C is located at the upper left of the circle, D is located at the upper right of the circle, OD is a radius from the center of the circle to the circle; the gray shaded part is between chord AC and its corresponding smaller arc AC, namely the small circular segment AC. Reasoning: It is known that OD is a radius and OD=6, so the circle radius r=6. It is also known that chord AC=6. Let the central angle corresponding to chord AC be θ, then the chord length formula is c=2r sin(θ/2). Substituting gives 6=2×6×sin(θ/2)=12sin(θ/2), so sin(θ/2)=1/2. Taking the angle corresponding to the small circular segment, θ/2=30°, therefore θ=60°=π/3. The area of the shaded circular segment equals the area of sector AOC minus the area of triangle AOC, and the circular segment formula S=(r^2/2)(θ−sinθ) may also be used directly. Substituting r=6 and θ=π/3, S=36/2×(π/3−sin(π/3))=18×(π/3−√3/2)=6π−9√3.
